note: APPROXIMATION. Areas are not drawn from a front-line map: every place in Ukraine is given the control marker of the nearest settlement listed in the Wikipedia module at that date (Voronoi cells around the settlement points, clipped to Ukraine's internationally recognised borders from Natural Earth). Cells with the same history are merged. Edges between groups are therefore only roughly where the front was, and areas far from listed places (open steppe, the rear) are guesses. Before 20220325 the cells carry the first step's marks. Wikipedia, 'Module:Russo-Ukrainian war detailed map' (from April 2024 together with 'Module:Russo-Ukrainian war overview map', which it extends), by Wikipedia contributors, CC BY-SA 4.0. Volunteer-edited: each settlement carries a marker for Ukrainian, Russian or contested control, set by editors from news reports and other maps. Each timeline step is the revision in force on a target date; the step's date is the date of that revision (the module is edited irregularly, so a revision can be weeks old on its target date). Revisions used: 20220325: detailed rev 1079235897 (2022-03-25); 20220410: detailed rev 1081969332 (2022-04-10); 20220831: detailed rev 1107703169 (2022-08-31); 20221005: detailed rev 1114321008 (2022-10-05); 20221115: detailed rev 1121400277 (2022-11-12); 20230601: detailed rev 1158082402 (2023-06-01); 20231231: detailed rev 1192511586 (2023-12-29); 20240601: detailed rev 1225916789 (2024-05-27), overview rev 1225916555 (2024-05-27); 20241231: detailed rev 1265512204 (2024-12-27), overview rev 1265512261 (2024-12-27); 20250601: detailed rev 1283172254 (2025-03-30), overview rev 1280984918 (2025-03-17); 20251231: detailed rev 1329188981 (2025-12-24), overview rev 1329853977 (2025-12-28); 20261007: detailed rev 1378976523 (2026-10-07), overview rev 1352386914 (2026-05-03).
